description: Place a Hyperliquid perp order on mainnet with optional stop-loss and take-profit. Only call when the user has asked to trade, and pass confirmTrade:true. Give sizeUsd for a market-style IOC order, or entryPx for a resting limit. With leverage set, the order is refused if its liquidation price lands inside a crowded wall unless override:true. Reports the fill status. A 1bp builder fee applies to fills.

confirmTrade.description: Must be true; set only after the user has asked to trade

entryPx.description: Limit price for a resting order; omit for an IOC order near the mark price

override.description: Place even if the liquidation price sits inside a wall

size.description: Size in coin units; optional if sizeUsd is set

sizeUsd.description: Order notional in USD; rounded to the coin lot size

name: hl_place_order
